competence_cases.family_note: Unnecessary-ask family, accounted arm: a correctly selected query becomes a burden violation the moment the required set is satisfied.
Unnecessary-ask family, unaccounted arm: the same unnecessary ask with a zero burden count is structurally inadmissible accounting.
Answer-replay family: an already-answered, already-ingested query is asked again instead of the affordable query covering the open gap.
Wrong-intent similarity-lure family, violation arm: the best-ranked but intent-incompatible record enters the selection.
Wrong-intent similarity-lure family, invariance arm: similarity rank carries no classification authority, so re-ranking the lure leaves the response byte-identical.

Intent-change family: the intent tuple shifts, the caller-derived verdicts follow it, and the selection retained from the previous intent now selects incompatible records while excluding the newly compatible one under a contradicted reason.

Incompatible-distractor family, invariance arm: adding incompatible distractor records to the frozen pool, with verdicts, exclusions, and projections extended coherently, leaves the selection VALID and the response bytes identical.
Incompatible-distractor family, violation arm: one added distractor is absorbed into the selection and the classification follows the facts to a conflict.
